heroHeadline: Meet the right person. Keep writing the story.
heroSupport: Connect through shared values and nurture relationships with depth.
proofIntentBody: The right person, the right values.
journeysSupport: At DeepMatch, every connection can open more meaningful experiences than you expect.
journeyFindBody: Connect with people who share your values, lifestyle, and what you truly care about.
journeyMapBody: Create experiences and memories worth keeping on a shared journey.
journeyCareBody: Helpful suggestions and content to nurture a more lasting bond.
pillarsSupport: Choose the path that fits — Couple Space does not require dating first.
pillarFindBody: Deeper profiles, selective discovery, likes and chat when both people agree.
pillarCoupleBody: A private space after a two-sided invite: memory map, milestones, and wishes.
pillarCompanionBody: Optional advisory services — fees and scope shown before you confirm.
howSupport: A few simple steps to open meaningful connections.
howStep1Body: Build an authentic profile that shows who you are and what you value.
howStep2Body: We connect you with people who share values and direction.
howStep3Body: Take the lead to get to know each other and explore new possibilities.
howStep4Body: Save memories in Couple Space, or book Companion services when you’re ready.
aiSupport: Profile and planning suggestions — no psychological diagnosis, no “compatibility %”.
aiCoachBody: Draft profile tips you preview before saving.
aiDateBody: Venue and theme ideas — you confirm before any booking.
aiGiftBody: Occasion-based ideas — no private partner data without opt-in.
couplePreviewSupport: A private space for two — maps and memories only you both can see.
lifestyleSupport: Additional extras open when ready — not external partner commerce.
lifestyleDemoBadge: Optional · fees shown before you confirm
trustSupport: Block and report are available; you control your data. DeepSafe is not a 24/7 emergency dispatch service.
trustBlockBody: Cut contact and report inappropriate behavior from inside the app.
trustPrivacyBody: Private journals and precise GPS are not used in matching.
trustAdultBody: The service is for people 18 years and older.
faqSupport: Answers for guests — public product information only.
finalCtaSupport: Meaningful connections always begin with a single step.
footerTagline: The right people create meaningful journeys.
metaTitle: DeepMatch — Meet the right person. Keep writing the story.
